questions.question: Platform engineering nima?
questions.explanation: Dasturchilarga software'ni mustaqil build, test, deploy va operatsiya qilish imkonini beradigan toolchain va self-service workflow'lar (IDP) loyihalash intizomi.

questions.question: "Platform as a product" nima?
questions.explanation: Ichki platformani mahsulot sifatida ko'rish: ichki dasturchilar — mijoz, product manager feedback yig'adi, adoption'ni o'lchaydi va DevEx'ni iterativ yaxshilaydi.

questions.question: Spotify Backstage nima?
questions.explanation: Yagona developer portali qurish uchun ochiq CNCF framework: markaziy Software Catalog, TechDocs (docs as code) va Software Templates (golden path).

questions.question: Platform engineering'da software template nima?
questions.explanation: Bir bosishda CI/CD, Dockerfile, Helm chart, monitoring dashboard va security scan'lari tayyor, talablarga mos mikroservis yaratadigan scaffolding.

questions.question: Developer Experience (DevEx) nima?
questions.explanation: Dasturchi uchun kod yozish, test, debug va deploy qilish qanchalik ishqalanishsiz, intuitiv va samarali ekani.

questions.question: Developer Velocity Index (DVI) nima?
questions.explanation: Tashkilot tooling, madaniyat va amaliyotlari dasturchilarga qanchalik tez biznes qiymat yaratish imkonini berishini o'lchovchi framework (McKinsey).

questions.question: Crossplane (platform engineering) nima?
questions.explanation: Kubernetes'ni universal control plane'ga aylantiruvchi CNCF loyihasi — cloud resurslar (S3, RDS) Kubernetes CRD sifatida boshqariladi.

questions.question: Crossplane'da XRD nima?
questions.explanation: Platform jamoasi belgilaydigan custom API: bir nechta cloud resursini dasturchilar uchun bitta self-service abstraksiyaga jamlaydi (kind: DatabaseInstance).

questions.question: Kratix nima?
questions.explanation: Kubernetes'da multi-cloud, multi-cluster platformalar qurish framework'i — jamoalarga qayta ishlatiladigan infra va servis "Promise"larini yetkazadi.

questions.question: OpenFeature standarti nima?
questions.explanation: Feature flag boshqaruvi uchun tillar bo'ylab yagona SDK va API beradigan vendor-neytral CNCF standarti.

questions.question: Score spetsifikatsiyasi nima?
questions.explanation: Ilova qanday ishlashini target muhit (Kubernetes, Terraform) tafsilotlarini bilmasdan tasvirlaydigan dasturchi-markazli workload spetsifikatsiyasi.

questions.question: FinOps va uning uch fazasi (core concepts) qanday?
questions.explanation: Inform (ko'rinish, tag), Optimize (narxni kamaytirish, right-sizing), Operate (doimiy governance).

questions.question: Cloud unit economics (core concepts) nima?
questions.explanation: Cloud xarajatini biznes metrikasiga nisbatan o'lchash: aktiv foydalanuvchi uchun, tranzaksiya uchun, stream qilingan GB uchun xarajat.

questions.question: Cloud Savings Plan nima?
questions.explanation: yoki 3 yillik soatlik sarf majburiyati evaziga compute (EC2, Fargate, Lambda) uchun 72% gacha chegirma beruvchi moslashuvchan narx modeli.

questions.question: Reserved Instances (RI) nima?
questions.explanation: Aniq instance oilasi, OS va region'ga bog'langan 1 yoki 3 yillik muddatli chegirma modeli.

questions.question: Spot instance (core concepts) nima?
questions.explanation: Provayderning bo'sh sig'imi 90% gacha arzon, lekin 2 daqiqalik ogohlantirish bilan qaytarib olinishi mumkin — stateless, uzilishga chidamli workload'lar uchun.

questions.question: Infracost (core concepts) nima?
questions.explanation: CI PR'larida Terraform'ni parse qilib, deploy'dan oldin oylik xarajat farqini ko'rsatadigan FinOps tool.

questions.question: Cloud Custodian nima?
questions.explanation: Cloud xavfsizligi va xarajat boshqaruvi uchun ochiq qoida engine'i: YAML policy bilan tag'siz instance'larni to'xtatish, bo'sh DB'larni o'chirish, compliance'ni majburlash.

questions.question: Kubernetes right-sizing (core concepts) nima?
questions.explanation: CPU/xotira requests/limits ni tarixiy telemetriya asosida moslash — over-provisioning va isrofni yo'qotish.

questions.question: Serverless va Kubernetes'da scale-to-zero nima?
questions.explanation: Trafik yoki navbat bo'lmaganda replikalar 0 gacha tushiriladi (KEDA, Knative) — bo'sh davrda compute xarajati yo'q; narxi — cold start.

questions.question: Karpenter consolidation (core concepts) nima?
questions.explanation: Kam yuklangan node'larni aniqlab, optimal almashtirish node'ini hisoblab, pod'larni ko'chirib, bo'sh node'larni o'chirish.

questions.question: Multi-tenant Kubernetes klaster nima?
questions.explanation: Bir nechta jamoa yoki tashqi mijozlar bo'lishadigan bitta fizik klaster; Namespace, NetworkPolicy, RBAC va ResourceQuota bilan ajratiladi (soft multi-tenancy).

questions.question: `vcluster` (core concepts) nima?
questions.explanation: Host klaster namespace'lari ichida to'liq funksional izolyatsiyalangan virtual control plane'lar ishlatadigan ochiq tool — kuchliroq multi-tenancy.

questions.question: Zero Trust Network Architecture (ZTNA) nima?
questions.explanation: Private VPC ichida bo'lishidan qat'i nazar har foydalanuvchi, qurilma va servis uchun qat'iy identity tekshiruvi va shifrlangan aloqa (mTLS) talab qiladigan xavfsizlik modeli.

questions.question: SPIFFE/SPIRE nima?
questions.explanation: Workload identity standarti (SPIFFE) va uning implementatsiyasi (SPIRE): kernel va kubelet attestation asosida mikroservislarga qisqa muddatli, avtomatik rotatsiya qilinadigan X.509 SVID beradi.

questions.question: Policy as Code (PaC) nima?
questions.explanation: Compliance va operatsion qoidalarni mashina o'qiy oladigan kod (OPA Rego, Kyverno) sifatida yozish, test qilish va CI/CD hamda admission'da majburlash.

questions.question: Open Policy Agent (OPA) nima?
questions.explanation: Strukturali JSON/YAML input'ni Rego tilidagi deklarativ mantiqqa nisbatan baholaydigan umumiy maqsadli ochiq policy engine.

questions.question: Kyverno (core concepts) nima?
questions.explanation: % YAML'da yoziladigan Kubernetes-native policy engine: validate, mutate, generate va image imzosini tekshirish.

questions.question: HashiCorp Vault nima?
questions.explanation: Markaziy secret boshqaruvi: dynamic secret'lar, PKI/CA boshqaruvi va encryption as a service (Transit).

questions.question: External Secrets Operator (core concepts) nima?
questions.explanation: Tashqi vault'lardan (AWS Secrets Manager, Vault) secret'larni nativ Kubernetes Secret ga sinxronlaydigan operator.

questions.question: Cosign keyless signing (core concepts) nima?
questions.explanation: Image'larni Fulcio'ning qisqa muddatli OIDC sertifikati bilan imzolash va Rekor transparency log'ga yozish — statik PGP/private key saqlash kerak emas.

questions.question: SBOM (core concepts) nima?
questions.explanation: Container yoki binary ichidagi barcha paket, kutubxona va tranzitiv dependency'larning mashina o'qiy oladigan ro'yxati (CycloneDX, SPDX).

questions.question: SLSA framework (core concepts) nima?
questions.explanation: Build yaxlitligi, hermetic sandbox build va soxtalashtirib bo'lmaydigan provenance standartlarini belgilovchi xavfsizlik framework'i.

questions.question: eBPF nima?
questions.explanation: Kernel source'ini o'zgartirmasdan kernel ichida xavfsiz (verifier tekshirgan) sandbox dasturlarni bajarish texnologiyasi — tez tarmoq (Cilium), observability (Hubble) va runtime security (Falco) uchun.

questions.question: Falco (core concepts) nima?
questions.explanation: eBPF orqali kernel syscall'larini tahlil qilib, container'dagi ruxsatsiz faoliyatni (shell ochish, /etc/shadow o'qish) aniqlab alert beruvchi CNCF runtime security tool.

questions.question: Cilium (core concepts) nima?
questions.explanation: eBPF asosidagi Kubernetes CNI, service mesh va tarmoq xavfsizligi plugin'i: L3–L7 routing va shaffof shifrlash.

questions.question: Gateway API (core concepts) nima?
questions.explanation: Ingress vorisi: rollarga ajratilgan resurslar (GatewayClass, Gateway, HTTPRoute) va nativ trafik bo'lish.

questions.question: KEDA (core concepts) nima?
questions.explanation: Tashqi event metrikalari (SQS navbat uzunligi, Kafka consumer lag) bo'yicha workload'ni 0 dan yuzlabgacha scale qiladigan autoscaler.

questions.question: Istio Ambient Mesh (core concepts) nima?
questions.explanation: Sidecar'siz mesh: har node'da ztunnel (L4 mTLS) va ixtiyoriy namespace bo'yicha waypoint proxy (L7 routing).

questions.question: Distributed consensus (core concepts) nima?
questions.explanation: Klasterdagi mustaqil node'lar tarmoq bo'linishiga qaramay qiymat va state machine log'i bo'yicha kelishishiga imkon beruvchi algoritmlar (Raft, Paxos) — etcd, Consul, CockroachDB.

questions.question: WAL (core concepts) nima?
questions.explanation: O'zgarishlar xotira/ma'lumot fayllariga qo'llanishidan oldin append-only log'ga diskka yoziladi — crash'da durability kafolati.

questions.question: DB connection pooling (core concepts) nima?
questions.explanation: Qat'iy sonli tayyor DB ulanishlarini qayta ishlatish (PgBouncer, RDS Proxy) — minglab client DB xotirasi va process limitlarini tugatmaydi.

questions.question: DB sharding (core concepts) nima?
questions.explanation: Qatorlarni shard key bo'yicha (user_id % 10) bir nechta mustaqil fizik DB instance'ga gorizontal bo'lish. Shard'lararo so'rov va tranzaksiya qiyinlashadi.

questions.question: Read-write splitting (core concepts) nima?
questions.explanation: Yozish (INSERT, UPDATE) primary'ga, o'qish (SELECT) asinxron replica'larga.

questions.question: Replication lag nima?
questions.explanation: Primary'da commit qilingan tranzaksiya asinxron replica'da qo'llanishigacha bo'lgan kechikish — replica'dan o'qishda eski ma'lumot ko'rinishi mumkin.

questions.question: Mikroservislarda dual-write muammosi nima?
questions.explanation: Ilova DB'ga va message queue'ga alohida yozishga urinadi — biri yiqilsa ma'lumot nomuvofiq bo'ladi (umumiy tranzaksiya yo'q). Yechim: outbox yoki CDC.

questions.question: Transactional Outbox (core concepts) nima?
questions.explanation: Event biznes ma'lumot bilan bitta ACID tranzaksiyada outbox jadvaliga yoziladi; alohida jarayon (CDC/Debezium yoki poller) uni Kafka'ga publish qiladi.

questions.question: Saga pattern (core concepts) nima?
questions.explanation: Distributed tranzaksiya lokal tranzaksiyalar ketma-ketligi sifatida; qadam yiqilsa compensating tranzaksiyalar bilan orqaga qaytariladi (choreography yoki orchestration).

questions.question: Event sourcing (core concepts) nima?
questions.explanation: Holat o'zgarishlari joriy qiymatni ustidan yozmasdan o'zgarmas event'lar append-only ketma-ketligi sifatida saqlanadi.

questions.question: CQRS (core concepts) nima?
questions.explanation: O'qish va yozishni alohida modellar/DB'larga ajratish — yozish va tez o'qish mustaqil optimallashadi; read model eventual consistent.

questions.question: Anycast IP nima?
questions.explanation: Bir xil IP'ni bir nechta global serverlar BGP orqali e'lon qiladi; trafik topologik eng yaqin serverga boradi (DNS root, CDN, Global Accelerator).

questions.question: CDN nima?
questions.explanation: Web resurslarni foydalanuvchiga yaqin cache'laydigan global proxy server tarmog'i — latency kamayadi va trafik sakrashlari yutiladi.

questions.question: HoL blocking (core concepts) nima?
questions.explanation: FIFO navbatda bitta yo'qolgan/kechikkan paket keyingi barchasini to'xtatadi; HTTP/3 (QUIC, UDP) stream'larni mustaqil qilib hal qiladi.

questions.question: AWS Direct Connect / Azure ExpressRoute nima?
questions.explanation: On-prem data center va cloud provayder o'rtasida public internetni chetlab o'tuvchi maxsus fizik optik ulanish.

questions.question: AWS Transit Gateway (core concepts) nima?
questions.explanation: Yuzlab VPC, VPN va Direct Connect'ni bitta boshqariladigan gateway orqali ulaydigan hub-and-spoke router.

questions.question: PrivateLink (core concepts) nima?
questions.explanation: VPC subnet'larini cloud servislari yoki SaaS vendor'larga public internetsiz backbone orqali ulaydigan private tarmoq interfeyslari.

questions.question: Multi-region active-active (core concepts) nima?
questions.explanation: To'liq ishlaydigan infra bir vaqtda bir nechta region'da; foydalanuvchi eng yaqin region'ga yo'naltiriladi, ma'lumot real vaqtda replikatsiya qilinadi (konflikt hal qilish strategiyasi shart).

questions.question: DR failover routing nima?
questions.explanation: Primary health check yiqilganda global trafikni avtomatik zaxira region'ga yo'naltiradigan DNS policy (Route 53 failover).

questions.question: Pilot Light DR (core concepts) nima?
questions.explanation: Kritik DB'lar ikkinchi region'ga doimiy replikatsiya, minimal yadro infra ishlab turadi; to'liq compute faqat avariyada yaratiladi.

questions.question: Warm Standby DR (core concepts) nima?
questions.explanation: Ikkinchi region'da prod'ning kichraytirilgan, to'liq ishlaydigan nusxasi doim ishlaydi va failover'da darhol scale up qilinadi.

questions.question: Serverless'da cold start (core concepts) nima?
questions.explanation: Provayder kodni yuklashi, microVM yaratishi va runtime'ni init qilishi kerak bo'lgan request'dagi qo'shimcha kechikish.

questions.question: Lambda SnapStart nima?
questions.explanation: Init qilingan runtime'ning (dastlab JVM, endi Python/.NET ham) shifrlangan Firecracker microVM snapshot'ini cache'lab, keyingi cold start'larni tez tiklash.

questions.question: API Gateway nima?
questions.explanation: Kiruvchi API trafigini boshqaradigan application-layer reverse proxy: autentifikatsiya, rate limiting, validatsiya, analitika.

questions.question: gRPC va REST farqi.
questions.explanation: REST odatda HTTP/1.1 + JSON matn; gRPC — HTTP/2 + binary Protobuf: multiplexing, ikki tomonlama streaming, yuqori throughput, qat'iy contract. Brauzer va debug'da REST qulayroq.

questions.question: GraphQL va REST farqi.
questions.explanation: REST qat'iy endpoint'lar beradi; GraphQL client'ga bitta so'rovda aynan kerakli maydonlarni olish imkonini beradi (over/under-fetching yo'q), lekin caching, N+1 va so'rov murakkabligini cheklash qiyinroq.

questions.question: Webhook payload'ini HMAC-SHA256 bilan tekshirish nima?
questions.explanation: Request body'ning umumiy secret bilan hisoblangan HMAC'ini header'dagi imzo bilan constant-time solishtirish — webhook haqiqiy jo'natuvchidanligini tasdiqlash (replay'ga qarshi timestamp ham).

questions.question: JWT tuzilishi qanday?
questions.explanation: Nuqta bilan ajratilgan uch qism: Header (algoritm), Payload (claim'lar: sub, exp), Signature. Payload shifrlanmagan — faqat imzolangan.

questions.question: OAuth 2.0 va OpenID Connect farqi.
questions.explanation: OAuth 2.0 — API ruxsatlari uchun access token beruvchi avtorizatsiya framework'i; OIDC — uning ustidagi identity qatlami, autentifikatsiya uchun ID token beradi.

questions.question: RBAC nima?
questions.explanation: Ruxsatlar alohida foydalanuvchilarga emas, rollarga beriladi; foydalanuvchi rol a'zoligiga ko'ra ruxsat oladi.

questions.question: ABAC nima?
questions.explanation: Kontekst atributlarini (bo'lim, resurs tag'lari, vaqt, IP) baholab real vaqtda kirish qarorini chiqarish.

questions.question: CloudTrail va CloudWatch farqi.
questions.explanation: CloudTrail — audit uchun har API chaqiruvni yozadi; CloudWatch — operatsion metrikalarni kuzatadi va log'larni jamlaydi.

questions.question: GuardDuty (core concepts) nima?
questions.explanation: CloudTrail, VPC Flow Logs va EKS audit log'larini ML bilan tahlil qilib, buzilgan instance'larni aniqlaydigan tahdid aniqlash servisi.

questions.question: Security Hub (core concepts) nima?
questions.explanation: Akkauntlar bo'ylab compliance holati (CIS, PCI-DSS) va xavfsizlik topilmalarini jamlaydigan markaziy dashboard.

questions.question: Amazon Inspector (core concepts) nima?
questions.explanation: EC2, ECR image va Lambda'larni dasturiy zaifliklarga avtomatik skanerlovchi servis.

questions.question: AWS KMS (core concepts) nima?
questions.explanation: Cloud storage va ilovalarda ishlatiladigan shifrlash kalitlarini yaratish va boshqarish servisi.

questions.question: Envelope encryption nima?
questions.explanation: Katta hajmli ma'lumot Data Encryption Key (DEK) bilan, DEK esa KMS root kaliti bilan shifrlanadi; shifrlangan DEK ma'lumot yonida saqlanadi.

questions.question: Secrets Manager va Parameter Store (core concepts) farqi.
questions.explanation: Secrets Manager — avtomatik rotation va cross-account kirish; Parameter Store — soddaroq, ierarxik key-value konfiguratsiya ombori.

questions.question: Infrastructure drift detection nima?
questions.explanation: Ishlab turgan resurslarni IaC state bilan avtomatik solishtirib, ruxsatsiz qo'lda o'zgarishlar haqida ogohlantirish (terraform plan muntazam, -detailed-exitcode).

questions.question: Terratest nima?
questions.explanation: Terraform bilan haqiqiy infra yaratib, endpoint'larni tekshirib, keyin o'chiradigan integration test'lar yozish uchun Go kutubxonasi.

questions.question: Checkov (core concepts) nima?
questions.explanation: Terraform, CloudFormation va Kubernetes manifest'larini xavfsizlik misconfiguration'lariga skanerlovchi IaC statik tahlil tool'i.

questions.question: OpenTofu nima?
questions.explanation: Terraform'ning ochiq, community boshqaradigan fork'i (MPL 2.0), Linux Foundation qoshida — Terraform BSL'ga o'tgandan keyin paydo bo'lgan.

questions.question: PromQL nima?
questions.explanation: Prometheus time series'larini filtrlash, agregatsiya qilish va matematik funksiyalar bilan hisoblash uchun read-only so'rov tili.

questions.question: Loki LogQL nima?
questions.explanation: Log stream'larini filtrlash va xom log matnidan real vaqtda metrika chiqarish uchun Prometheus'dan ilhomlangan so'rov tili.

questions.question: Grafana Tempo (core concepts) nima?
questions.explanation: Span'larni arzon object storage'da saqlaydigan, Elasticsearch talab qilmaydigan distributed tracing backend.

questions.question: OpenTelemetry Collector nima?
questions.explanation: Telemetriyani qabul qiladigan, qayta ishlaydigan (batch, redact, sample) va bir nechta backend'ga eksport qiladigan proxy pipeline komponenti.

questions.question: Hubble (core concepts) nima?
questions.explanation: eBPF asosida servislararo aloqa grafi va tarmoq latency'sini vizualizatsiya qiluvchi observability platformasi.

questions.question: Chaos Mesh (core concepts) nima?
questions.explanation: Resilience'ni sinash uchun CRD'lar orqali nosozlik kiritadigan Kubernetes-native chaos operatori.

questions.question: DAST (core concepts) nima?
questions.explanation: Ishlab turgan web ilovaga tashqaridan hujum qilib runtime misconfiguration, XSS va SQL injection'ni topish.

questions.question: SAST (core concepts) nima?
questions.explanation: Compile qilinmagan source kodni tahlil qilib zaifliklar va kodlash xatolarini aniqlash.

questions.question: SCA (core concepts) nima?
questions.explanation: Third-party ochiq dependency'larni ma'lum CVE'lar bazasiga nisbatan skanerlash.

questions.question: Container escape nima?
questions.explanation: Container ichida kod ishlatayotgan hujumchi izolyatsiya chegarasini buzib host OS ustidan nazorat olishi (kernel zaifligi, privileged, hostPath, docker.sock).

questions.question: Rootless Docker / Podman (core concepts) nima?
questions.explanation: Daemon va container'larni imtiyozsiz user namespace'da ishlatish — breakout bo'lsa ham host root olinmaydi.

questions.question: Pod Security Admission (core concepts) nima?
questions.explanation: Namespace bo'yicha Privileged, Baseline yoki Restricted xavfsizlik standartlarini majburlovchi ichki admission controller.

questions.question: PDB (core concepts) nima?
questions.explanation: Ixtiyoriy uzilishlarda (node drain) replikatsiyalangan servisning bir vaqtda nechta pod'i o'chishi mumkinligini cheklovchi siyosat.

questions.question: HPA (core concepts) nima?
questions.explanation: CPU, xotira yoki tashqi metrikalarga ko'ra pod replikalari sonini avtomatik o'zgartirish.

questions.question: VPA (core concepts) nima?
questions.explanation: Tarixiy foydalanish tahliliga ko'ra container CPU/xotira request/limit'larini avtomatik moslash.

questions.question: NodeLocal DNSCache (core concepts) nima?
questions.explanation: DNS so'rovlarini har node'da lokal cache'laydigan DaemonSet — CoreDNS bottleneck'i va ndots:5 latency bo'ronlarini yo'qotadi.

questions.question: GitOps reconciliation loop nima?
questions.explanation: GitOps operatori Git'dagi desired state'ni klasterning live holati bilan doimiy solishtirib, drift'ni avtomatik tuzatadigan fon jarayoni.

questions.question: Progressive delivery (core concepts) nima?
questions.explanation: Canary, avtomatik metrika tahlili va feature flag'larni birlashtirib, funksiyalarni minimal blast radius bilan chiqaradigan CD evolyutsiyasi.

questions.question: SRE blameless post-mortem tamoyili nima?
questions.explanation: Inson xatosi tekshiruvning xulosasi emas, boshlanish nuqtasi; e'tibor tizimli himoyalarni kuchaytirishga.
